newsitem.title: UK: UK ad body shows Website to Labour Party.
newsitem.headline: UK ad body shows Website to Labour Party.

text.p: The Advertising Association said on Tuesday it was demonstrating its new Internet Website at the Labour Party Conference in Blackpool, in a bid to make politicians more aware of what the AA describes as the benefits of advertising.
The AA said the Website would provide regularly updated information about the hottest issues facing the advertising industry.
On part of the Website, called "Executive Briefs", covers major issues including alcohol and tobacco advertising, violence in advertising and advertising aimed at children.
The Website is located at http://www.adassoc.org.uk.
